notes.title: 2024.07.13 Update instructions
notes.notes:
[h1][b]v1.0.2 New weapon characteristic added[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Speeding: There is a 10% chance that the weapon's flight speed will increase by 100%.This characteristic is effective for all weapons.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fighting spirit: Each time an enemy is penetrated, the weapon's attack power increases by 10%.This characteristic is effective for all weapons.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Freeze: After eliminating the target enemy, there is a 10% chance to freeze nearby enemies for 1 second.This characteristic is effective for all weapons.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Explosion: After eliminating the target enemy, there is a 10% chance of an explosion, causing damage equivalent to the weapon's attack power to nearby enemies.This characteristic is effective for all weapons.
[/list]

notes.title: 2024.07.10 Update instructions
notes.notes:
[h1][b]V1.0.1 New weapon features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fatal: There is a 10% chance to directly eliminate enemies with health below 30%.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Excitement: When eliminating enemies, there is a 10% chance that the weapon will fly freely for 1 second. This feature is shared by all weapons.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Standby: There is a 10% chance that the weapon will rotate in place for 1 second after the target is locked and lost. This feature is shared by all weapons.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Backward Defense: After locking the target and losing it, there is a 10% chance that the weapon will fly towards the production base for 1 second. This feature is shared by all weapons.
[/list]
